title: T9 — Inception analysis
body:
# Inception analysis — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Current state

The plan measured the starting state at `main@48fc44c` on 2026-11-16: the artefact model, ADM phases and contracts, the delivery design gate, compliance and waivers, the capability assessment and the Phase-H outcome were all ABSENT (`git grep` returned zero hits across `crates` and `migrations`). P0's five Preliminary documents existed as proposed content only: `architecture-principles` (PF-1), `adm-profile` (ADM-1), `artifact-standard` (AS-1), `maturity-assessment` (MA-1) and `skills-assessment` (SA-1), each stating proposed for P0 acceptance. At HEAD the delivered capability adds the eleven tables, the 26 `architecture.*` actions, the four events, the Architecture console destination and the named real-Postgres suites. This rework verifies that those test files and names exist at HEAD.

## Reuse sources

`wbs_node` and the plan spine from T1; `governed_asset` for requirements, principles, ADRs and supersession; `trace_link` for the trace chain; `catalogue_entry` for the project-type and card-type matrix; `process_step.kind='gate'` for parked gates; the approval primitive for dual control; `document` plus MinIO for artefact documents; and T3's PM gate routing. The analysis question for each is whether the capability can consume it without a second store of the same fact.

## Build vs reuse

The eleven architecture tables are built, because §10.3 gives an architecture artefact and its contract their own tables and `governed_asset.kind` is explicitly not widened for them (plan §6). The Board, the approvals, the trace links, the documents, the WBS phase nodes and the PM routing are reused, never rebuilt. ArchiMate modelling, a live metamodel and a diagram renderer are out of scope: a diagram is a document with typed metadata and a viewpoint (§8.6).

## Risks

The obvious build risks are a repository that accepts untyped rows (v1-p81-5), a Board that can govern while still draft (v1-p81-4), a profile adopted on an arbitrary UUID (v1-w2a-3), a cross-project contract supersession (v1-w2a-4), an overstating phase-progress read (v1-w2a-6), and a Phase-H gate that checks existence rather than exactly-one (v1-p81-6). Each is an open ledger finding, not a hypothetical.

## Open questions

The plan's D5 Verify target `crates/api/tests/togaf_h_change.rs::a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` is absent at HEAD; the kata proof lives in `crates/actions/tests/togaf_kata_outcome.rs` and the change proof in `togaf_h_change.rs::a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row`. Whether the console and seed checks pass was not executed by this authoring pass.
